faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes V-Class use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. The W638 (1996–2003) used OM601 or OM602 diesel engines. The W447 generation started with the OM651 2.1-litre diesel (2014–2025) and switched to the OM654 2.0-litre diesel from the 2025 refresh. The EQV is fully electric — no combustion engine.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild the V-Class EQV electric motor?
faqLeft.a: No. The EQV is fully electric and out of scope for our workshop. We only rebuild combustion engines — diesel V-Class variants are our expertise. This page exists to make that clear.

faqLeft.q: How much does a V-Class diesel engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for all diesel engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my V-Class?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have an OM651 or OM654 (W447) or an earlier OM601/OM602 (W638) before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM651 V-Class engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM651 is a well-understood engine with known wear patterns — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild OM654 V-Class engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The OM654 is the current engine fitted from the 2025 refresh. No independently confirmed widespread issues as of August 2026 research, but we service it to the same high standard as our other V-Class rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used V-Class diesel engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my V-Class if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a V-Class engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most V-Class diesel owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
